speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I see you have fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. To narrow this down, were the flank pain and fever on the same side as any recent swelling or redness? Also, have you noticed any changes in your urine, such as cloudiness, blood, or a strong odor?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis. The persistence of fever and flank pain despite treatment for sinusitis, along with new onset fatigue, is classic for a kidney infection. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis and Urine Culture.
